hero.title: Igor IansenFull-stack development, from interface to database.
hero.subtitle: I'm studying Multiplatform Software Development at Fatec Jacareí. Here, I share academic and personal projects, including work developed during hackathons.
sobre.texto.1: I'm studying Multiplatform Software Development at Fatec Jacareí and looking for my first opportunity as a full-stack developer.
sobre.texto.2: I enjoy working across an entire project, from the interface to the API and database. I mainly use JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Express and PostgreSQL in academic and personal projects, as well as hackathons.
sobre.texto.3: I learn best by developing projects and solving problems in practice. I've also started studying cybersecurity and artificial intelligence, which I plan to explore in greater depth.
info.formacao.texto: I'm studying Multiplatform Software Development at Fatec Jacareí and am currently in my second semester.
info.foco.texto: I'm currently improving my full-stack skills across front-end, back-end and database development.
info.hobbies.texto: Outside programming, I play drums and enjoy emo and alternative music, games and gothic culture.
